visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed, edge-to-edge image gallery for adventure detail pages. Each slide is an image only (no overlaid heading, description, or CTA). Slide indicator dots are centered below and circular prev/next controls overlay the vertical center of the slide area. A single-slide instance shows just the image with no controls.
contentPattern: Repeating rows, each a slide: cell 1 is the image (mandatory), cell 2 is optional text (usually empty for adventure galleries).
usage: Hero image gallery at the top of an adventure detail page.
